label: Greedy list scheduling
subgoals: Hand each task in order to the earliest-free worker
Break ties toward the lowest-numbered worker
Take the largest worker load as the makespan

label: Longest task first
subgoals: Sort tasks from longest to shortest
Compare the new makespan with the unsorted one

label: Lower bounds on makespan
subgoals: Divide the total work by the worker count
Take the larger value as the lower bound
